name: Provision of Sports Kits to Players Participating at the National Level
benefit: - Under this scheme, sports kits are provided through sports associations to players and team members participating in various sports disciplines at the national level across different age groups. - Approximately 1,000 players benefit from the scheme annually.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a player or a member of a team representing Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant or their team must be participating in national-level sports competitions.
